answer: Map the economy as a trust graph and run random walks from trusted seeds. Honest agents cluster in one dense mesa of mutual work history; a sybil farm hangs off it by a few thin attack edges, so walks from a trusted seed almost never reach it. Newcomers found only through those thin edges get flagged and throttled. To look honest, an attacker must earn real edges to real agents - each costs completed work, like signing an ivory contract with a quill. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand real relationships, so the farm pays full price.
